cultural.vision_reason: This is an Italian Renaissance maiolica albarello (drug jar) with a shield of arms, "yhs" monogram, and a man's profile in Renaissance dress — a classic European ceramic tradition, not an object made or used by the San people of Botswana.

physical.title: albarello
physical.summary: Albarello, earthenware covered on the outside with a presumed tin-glaze and inside with a thin brownish glaze. Painted decoration in zones including; San Bernardino rays, tendrils and flowers and four roundels with a) a shield of arms, green a bend white, b)a ground decorated with triple dots and letters "yhs", c) a profile head of a man with a feather in his hat, d) "yhs" as in b). Below, bands of decoration: peacock feathers.
